attempted_claim: Let MPT be the Polish group of measure-preserving transformations of the standard non-atomic probability space ([0,1], Lebesgue) with the weak topology acting by conjugation on the Polish subspace of ergodic rank-one mixing transformations. Determine whether this restricted conjugacy equivalence relation is generically ergodic for countable-structure invariants, i.e. whether every Borel homomorphism from it to the isomorphism relation of countable structures maps a comeager subset of the rank-one mixing class into a single isomorphism class. A complete answer is either a proof of this generic-ergodicity non-classification property or an explicit countable language and Borel invariant assigning non-isomorphic countable structures to a non-meager set of pairwise non-conjugate rank-one mixing transformations.

Fused retrieval found no verbatim prior statement of Y meager-in-itself singleton-comeager, but under STANDARD mechanical implication by nearest prior work defeats originality. Broader Foreman-Weiss turbulence and Peng unbalancedness address intended Polish ergodic classification, not this degenerate relative-category trick, so they neither cover nor rescue it; JEMS 2004 body inspected in full and affirmatively excludes the Y-degeneracy claim. value: ADMISSION_DEFECT: literal yes is degenerate vacuity holding for every equivalence relation on Y including equality, hence gives no Hjorth-type classification obstruction; DRAFT admits this. Second-horn impossibility is mere category degeneracy from Y meager in itself. Polish-premise refutation is a type/normalization error in the topic as stated. Under TARGET policy a proof still needs originality and value, and vacuity, cheap mismatch, direct lookup, or arbitrary-parameter facts fail value even if literally true/false. A rigorously established exact invariant of a motivated natural object could pass narrowly, but an unexplained degenerate universal quantifier over an arbitrary meager-in-itself subspace is not such a fact. No bounded addition without new topology and new direction can cure intrinsic vacuity, so not repairable.
